source.note: dirty paths are this campaign's own artifacts; no primordial source modified

seed_policy.rule: every stochastic draw derives from a declared attempt seed; no implicit clock/hash seeding
seed_policy.why: PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent draws have burned this codebase before; seeds must be reconstructible from the attempt_id alone so a replay needs no runtime state

declared_capabilities_required._rationale: e01 is CPU economics over a finite addressable region; GPU is NOT required. Declaring needs_gpu=False keeps this experiment runnable on hosts that have none.

capability_match.needs_redis: NOT REQUIRED after all - the in-process path is Redis-free; redis stays available but e01 does not depend on it
capability_match.verdict: PASS - and STRONGER than before: e01 now requires neither GPU nor Redis, only a git worktree + PM_TAG. That is the most portable e01 can be.

preregistration_ref: PREREGISTRATION.md (written before the codebase survey, deliberately)

reuse_decision._principle: VI: reuse one definition rather than forking a second. The survey found a direct in-process path that needs no broker, worker, Redis, schtasks or Claude session.

world_primitive.make_world: primordial/soup/b1/common.py:25 -> (mech, world_id); a world is ONE integer (gen_seed)
world_primitive.spec: primordial/qd/e4_run.py:39 Spec(gen_seed); T,S,W are DERIVED from mech, not chosen
world_primitive.encounter: primordial/soup/b1/np_world.py:26 NpEncounter(mech, wid, record=None, cheat='', with_obs=True)

durable_row_path.job_contract: def job(ctx, **kwargs); ctx needs exactly 5 methods: emit, load_checkpoint, checkpoint, should_pause, progress
durable_row_path.admit: primordial/fabric/envelope.py:292 admit(env, kind='cpu', clock=None) - PURE when clock=None; refusal is a return value, not an exception
durable_row_path.smoke_job: primordial/fabric/selftest_jobs.py:51 emit_n(ctx, n=3) - no numpy world, no JIT
HARD_REQUIREMENTS: rows path must be inside a git worktree (rows.py:104-109)
use commit_every_s=10**9 and commit once at close, else one git commit per minute per writer

qualify_smoke_tests: primordial/tests/test_rows.py - RowWriter+commit_path in a throwaway git repo; NO redis
primordial/tests/test_c_r8_ap01_pairwise_d1.py - StubCtx + real job() end to end; best proof of the in-process path; NO redis
primordial/tests/test_r5_f1_envelope.py - pure CEILINGS/admit table tests; NO redis
primordial/tests/test_f8_worldcache.py - builds REAL worlds (E5.BrainSpec, E7.G7); fast world-construction proof

explicitly_NOT_reused.worker_broker_epoch: tightly coupled to Redis AND to the F:/Prometheus-worktrees path table (ops/round_clock.py:45-54). ops/residue.py flags any worker outside that table as FOREIGN_REPO and stop_registered() would KILL it. Reusing the fabric wholesale would make this campaign un-runnable on any other machine by construction.
explicitly_NOT_reused.worker_Ctx: fabric/worker.py:260 takes a live Redis handle and XADDs; write a 5-method ctx instead
explicitly_NOT_reused.launch path: schtasks -> powershell -> launch_lane.ps1 is Windows-only and non-substitutable; the in-process path replaces it entirely
